note: Fixed research parameters for Phase 1. These are EXAMPLE cost values for comparability between runs, not a universal market truth. No optimization is performed on any of these values in Phase 1.

BUY_HOLD.description: B0 — first admissible open entry, hold to end, costs included, dividends only when per-bar data exists

MA50.description: B1 — enter close>SMA50 & slope>0, exit close<SMA50, fills at next open

EMA21_EMA50.description: B2 — enter EMA21>EMA50 & close>EMA21, exit close<EMA21 or EMA21<EMA50, fills at next open

TREND_ATR.description: B3 — enter close>SMA50 & slope>0, causal trailing stop max(prevStop, highestCloseSinceEntry - k*ATR14), stop active next session, gap-aware
TREND_ATR.note: k=2.5 only in Phase 1; 1.5/2/3 explicitly NOT tested (no optimization)
